items.meaning: RFC 2119 的关键词之一，本文档中的这些关键词须按 [RFC2119] 中的规定解释。
items.constraint: 本文档中的关键词须按 [RFC2119] 中的规定解释

items.meaning: SMTP 响应码 220，表示准备开始 TLS。
SMTP 响应码 501，表示语法错误，即不允许带参数。
SMTP 响应码 454，表示由于临时原因导致 TLS 不可用。
当客户端收到 454 响应时，它必须决定是否继续 SMTP 会话；该决定基于本地策略。
items.constraint: 若客户端收到 454 响应，则必须决定是否继续 SMTP 会话
items.action: decide whether or not to continue the SMTP session
items.object: the SMTP session
items.condition: If the client receives the 454 response

items.meaning: 公开引用的 SMTP 服务器不得要求使用 STARTTLS 扩展才能本地投递邮件。
items.constraint: 公开引用的 SMTP 服务器不得要求使用 STARTTLS 扩展才能本地投递邮件
items.object: the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally

items.meaning: 任何 SMTP 服务器都可以依据 TLS 协商期间提供的认证信息，拒绝接受用于中继的邮件。
items.action: refuse to accept messages for relay
items.object: messages for relay
items.condition: based on authentication supplied during the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: 非公开引用的 SMTP 服务器可以依据 TLS 协商期间提供的认证信息，拒绝接受任何用于中继或本地投递的邮件。
items.action: refuse to accept any messages for relay or local delivery
items.object: any messages for relay or local delivery
items.condition: that is not publicly referenced
items.normative_subject: An SMTP server that is not publicly referenced

items.meaning: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced may require TLS negotiation before accepting any commands; in that case it SHOULD return reply code 530 to every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT
items.constraint: SHOULD return reply code 530 to every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT
items.object: the reply code
items.condition: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced may choose to require that the client perform a TLS negotiation before accepting any commands. In this case
items.exception: other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT

items.meaning: The text of reply code 530, indicating that a STARTTLS command must be issued first
ESMTP extension (RFC2034) that, when used by client and server, means the returned status code SHOULD be 5.7.0
items.constraint: SHOULD return status code 5.7.0
items.object: status code 5.7.0
items.condition: If the client and server are using the ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP extension [RFC2034]

items.meaning: After a 220 response to STARTTLS, the client MUST start the TLS negotiation before giving any other SMTP commands
items.constraint: MUST start the TLS negotiation before giving any other SMTP commands
items.object: the TLS negotiation
items.condition: After receiving a 220 response to a STARTTLS command

items.meaning: If after issuing STARTTLS a failure prevents the client from starting a TLS handshake, it SHOULD abort the connection
items.constraint: SHOULD abort the connection
items.object: the connection
items.condition: If, after having issued the STARTTLS command, the client finds out that some failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake

items.meaning: When the SMTP client uses pipelining as defined in RFC 2920, the STARTTLS command must be the last command in a group
items.constraint: must be the last command in a group
items.object: a group
items.condition: If the SMTP client is using pipelining as defined in RFC 2920

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，通信双方必须立即依据所达成的认证与隐私程度决定是否继续
items.constraint: 双方 MUST 立即决定是否继续
items.action: decide whether or not to continue
items.object: whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.condition: After the TLS handshake has been completed

items.meaning: 若客户端认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，应发出 SMTP QUIT 命令
items.constraint: 客户端 SHOULD 立即发出 QUIT
items.object: an SMTP QUIT command
items.condition: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: 若服务器认为认证或隐私级别不足，应对除 QUIT 外的每条命令以 554 码应答
items.constraint: 服务器 SHOULD 以 554 应答每条非 QUIT 命令
items.object: every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command)
items.condition: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后服务器必须丢弃任何非来自 TLS 协商的、从客户端获得的知识（如 EHLO 参数）
items.constraint: 服务器 MUST 丢弃非来自 TLS 协商的客户端知识
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后客户端必须丢弃任何非来自 TLS 协商的、从服务器获得的知识（如 SMTP 服务扩展列表）
items.constraint: 客户端 MUST 丢弃非来自 TLS 协商的服务器知识
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: 成功完成 TLS 协商后客户端应把 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令发送
items.constraint: 客户端 SHOULD 首条命令发送 EHLO
items.object: an EHLO command as the first command
items.condition: after a successful TLS negotiation

items.meaning: TLS 握手后响应 EHLO 返回的 SMTP 服务扩展列表可以不同于握手前返回的列表
items.object: the list returned before the TLS handshake
items.condition: received after the TLS handshake

items.meaning: 举例说明 SMTP 服务器可能不愿通告某 SASL 机制的支持，除非客户端在 TLS 握手中发送了合适的客户端证书
Both the client and the server must know whether a TLS session is active.
items.constraint: MUST know if there is a TLS session active
items.object: if there is a TLS session active
items.normative_subject: Both the client and the server

items.meaning: A client must not attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active.
items.constraint: MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active
items.object: a TLS session
items.condition: if a TLS session is already active

items.meaning: A server must not return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed.
items.constraint: MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed
items.object: the STARTTLS extension
items.condition: in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed

items.meaning: STARTTLS is a valid ESMTP extension when used on the Submission port.
The submission port is by definition not a publicly referenced SMTP server.
The STARTTLS extension can be useful on the Submission service by providing security and authentication.
SMTP is not an end-to-end mechanism.
If an SMTP client/server pair adds TLS privacy, they are not securing the transport from the originating mail user agent to the recipient.
Delivery of a single piece of mail may go between more than two SMTP servers.
Adding TLS privacy to one pair of servers does not mean the entire SMTP chain has been made private.
An SMTP server authenticating an SMTP client does not mean that the mail from the SMTP client was authenticated by the SMTP client when the client received it.
Both the SMTP client and server must check the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved.
items.constraint: must check the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved
items.normative_subject: Both the SMTP client and server

items.meaning: The decision about whether acceptable authentication or privacy was achieved is made locally, is implementation-dependent, and is beyond the scope of this document.
SMTP 客户端和服务器应当仔细注意 TLS 协商的结果
items.constraint: should note carefully the result of the TLS negotiation
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: 客户端在协商未提供隐私或强度不足、认证不够好时可以选择以立即 QUIT 结束会话
items.constraint: the client may choose to end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.action: choose to end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.object: the SMTP session
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 服务器可以选择不再接受任何 SMTP 命令
items.constraint: the server may choose to not accept any more SMTP commands
items.action: not accept any more SMTP commands
items.object: any more SMTP commands
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 服务器的 "250 STARTTLS" 响应，被中间人删除即可阻止客户端启动 TLS 会话
客户端和服务器必须能够被配置为在报文成功传输前要求对选定主机完成适当密码套件的 TLS 协商
items.constraint: both clients and servers MUST be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred
items.action: be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts
items.object: successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts
items.condition: before messages can be successfully transferred

items.meaning: 还应当提供在可能时使用 TLS 的附加选项
items.constraint: The additional option of using TLS when possible SHOULD also be provided
items.object: The additional option of using TLS when possible

items.meaning: 实现可以提供记录与某对端通信时使用了 TLS、并在后续会话未使用时产生告警的能力
items.constraint: An implementation MAY provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session
items.action: provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session
items.object: the ability to record that TLS was used ... and generating a warning
items.condition: if it is not used in a later session

items.meaning: 发生失败或错误时客户端应假设服务器将来仍可能协商 TLS，并在后续会话中尝试协商 TLS
items.constraint: should try negotiate TLS in a later session
items.action: try negotiate TLS in a later session
items.object: TLS
items.condition: If a failure or error occurs ... until some locally-chosen timeout occurs

items.meaning: 本地选定的超时到达后，客户端应把邮件退回发件人
items.constraint: the client should return the mail to the sender
items.action: return the mail to the sender
items.object: the mail
items.condition: until some locally-chosen timeout occurs, at which point

items.meaning: 若双方仅将 TLS 用于认证，客户端可以选择继续 SMTP 会话
items.constraint: the client may want to proceed with the SMTP session
items.object: the SMTP session
items.condition: if the client and server were only using TLS for authentication

items.meaning: TLS 握手开始之前的协议交互是明文进行的，可能被主动攻击者修改
客户端和服务器必须在 TLS 握手完成时丢弃握手开始前获得的所有知识
items.constraint: clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.object: any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.condition: upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: STARTTLS extension is not suitable for authenticating the author of an email message unless every hop in the delivery chain, including submission to the first SMTP server, is authenticated.
items.constraint: not suitable for authenticating the author unless every hop in the delivery chain, including the submission to the first SMTP server, is authenticated

items.meaning: The SMTP-AUTH proposal can be used to authenticate delivery.
MIME security multiparts can be used to authenticate the author of an email message.
The SASL EXTERNAL mechanism MAY be used with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity.
items.constraint: MAY be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity
items.object: in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity

items.meaning: An SMTP client may indicate an authentication mechanism to the server, perform an authentication protocol exchange, and optionally negotiate a security layer for subsequent protocol interactions during the session.
items.object: an authentication mechanism to the server

items.meaning: The SMTP extension includes a profile of SASL for SMTP.
An SMTP client may indicate an authentication mechanism to the server.
An SMTP client may perform an authentication protocol exchange.
An SMTP client may optionally negotiate a security layer for subsequent protocol interactions during this session.
During a mail transaction, an SMTP client may optionally specify a mailbox associated with the identity that submitted the message to the mail delivery system.
This document deprecates use of the 538 response code.
This document adds a new Enhanced Status Code.
This document adds a requirement to support the SASLprep profile for preparing authorization identities.
This document recommends use of RFC 3848 transmission types in the Received trace header field.
This document clarifies interaction with the SMTP PIPELINING extension.
The AUTH EHLO keyword contains as a parameter a space-separated list of the names of available SASL mechanisms.
The list of available mechanisms MAY change after a successful STARTTLS command.
items.constraint: MAY change after a successful STARTTLS command [SMTP-TLS]
items.condition: after a successful STARTTLS command [SMTP-TLS]

items.meaning: AUTH 是一个可选参数关键字，被加入 MAIL FROM 命令，并将 MAIL FROM 命令的最大行长扩展 500 个字符。
initial-response 是可选的初始客户端响应，若存在则必须按 [BASE64] 第 4 节编码或包含单个字符 "="。
items.constraint: 若存在，必须以 [BASE64] 第 4 节所述方式编码，或包含单个字符 "="
items.object: this response
items.condition: If present

items.meaning: 在 AUTH 命令成功完成后，同一会话中不得再发出更多 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: 同一会话中不得再发出更多 AUTH 命令
items.object: no more AUTH commands in the same session
items.condition: After an AUTH command has been successfully completed

items.meaning: 在成功的 AUTH 命令完成后，服务器必须以 503 应答拒绝任何进一步的 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: 服务器必须以 503 应答拒绝任何进一步的 AUTH 命令
items.object: any further AUTH commands with a 503 reply
items.condition: After a successful AUTH command completes

items.meaning: 邮件事务期间不允许使用 AUTH 命令；该期间发出的 AUTH 命令必须以 503 应答被拒绝。
items.constraint: 邮件事务期间发出的 AUTH 命令必须以 503 应答被拒绝
items.object: An AUTH command issued during a mail transaction with a 503 reply
items.condition: during a mail transaction

items.meaning: AUTH 命令发起客户端与服务器之间的 SASL 认证交换，客户端用 AUTH 命令的第一个参数指明所用的 SASL 机制。
当请求的认证机制无效（不支持或需要加密层）时，服务器用 504 应答拒绝 AUTH 命令
items.constraint: 无效认证机制 ⇒ 504 应答

items.meaning: 服务器支持的增强状态码扩展，支持时应返回 5.5.4 增强应答码
items.constraint: 支持 ESMTP-CODES 时应返回 5.5.4 增强应答码
items.object: a 5.5.4 enhanced response code
items.condition: If the server supports the [ESMTP-CODES] extension

items.meaning: 服务器质询以 334 应答发送，其文本部分包含 SASL 机制提供的 BASE64 编码串
该质询除 BASE64 编码的质询外不得包含任何其他文本
items.constraint: 质询不得含 BASE64 编码质询之外的任何文本
items.object: any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge

items.meaning: 客户端响应由一行包含 BASE64 编码串的内容构成
服务器收到单个 "*" 的取消响应时，必须发送 501 应答拒绝 AUTH 命令
items.constraint: 收到 "*" 响应必须用 501 应答拒绝 AUTH
items.object: the AUTH command by sending a 501 reply
items.condition: If the server receives such a response

items.meaning: 当初始响应参数被省略而选定机制要求初始客户端响应时，服务器必须按 [SASL] 第 5.1 节所述处理
items.constraint: 省略初始响应且机制要求初始响应 ⇒ 按 SASL 5.1 处理
items.object: as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL]
items.condition: If the initial response argument is omitted and the chosen mechanism requires an initial client response

items.meaning: 在 SMTP 中，不含数据的服务器质询定义为无文本部分的 334 应答
若使用初始响应参数会使 AUTH 命令超过行长度限制，客户端不得使用该参数
items.constraint: 超出行长度限制时禁用初始响应参数
items.object: the initial response parameter
items.condition: If use of the initial response argument would cause the AUTH command to exceed this length

items.meaning: 客户端在发送零长度初始响应时改为发送单个等号（"="）这一约定
items.constraint: 零长度初始响应必须以单个 "=" 传输
items.action: transmit the response as a single equals sign ("=")
items.object: the response
items.condition: If the client is transmitting an initial response of zero length

items.meaning: 服务器对在客户端不先发起认证交换的 SASL 机制下使用 initial-response 参数的 AUTH 命令的处理要求
items.constraint: 服务器必须以 501 应答拒绝该 AUTH 命令
items.object: the AUTH command with a 501 reply
items.condition: If the client uses an initial-response argument to the AUTH command with a SASL mechanism in which the client does not begin the authentication exchange

items.meaning: 使用增强状态码扩展的服务器在该情形下返回的增强状态码
items.constraint: 应返回增强状态码 5.7.0
items.object: an enhanced status code of 5.7.0
items.condition: in this case

items.meaning: 服务器无法对客户端响应进行 BASE64 解码时的处理要求
items.constraint: 必须以 501 应答（及增强状态码 5.5.2）拒绝 AUTH 命令
items.object: the AUTH command with a 501 reply (and an enhanced status code of 5.5.2)
items.condition: If the server cannot [BASE64] decode any client response

items.meaning: 客户端无法对服务器挑战进行 BASE64 解码时的处理要求
items.constraint: 必须使用 "*" 响应取消认证
items.action: cancel the authentication using the "*" response
items.object: the authentication
items.condition: If the client cannot BASE64 decode any of the server's challenges

items.meaning: 服务器与客户端对 BASE64 字母表之外字符的处理要求
items.constraint: 必须拒绝（而非忽略）BASE64 字母表未明确允许的任何字符
items.object: any character not explicitly allowed by the BASE64 alphabet
items.condition: In particular

items.meaning: BASE64 字符集，其允许字符决定合法编码范围
items.constraint: 必须拒绝在字符串末尾以外的位置含填充字符 '=' 的 BASE64 字符序列
items.object: any sequence of BASE64 characters that contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string
items.condition: contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string

items.meaning: 客户端与服务器对认证挑战/响应的最大编码长度的处理能力要求
items.constraint: 必须能处理其支持机制产生的挑战与响应的最大编码尺寸
items.object: the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms

items.meaning: 服务器收到超过其认证缓冲区长度的行时使 AUTH 命令失败并返回 500 应答的行为
使用增强状态码扩展的服务器在认证行超长情形下返回的增强状态码
items.constraint: 应返回增强状态码 5.5.6
items.object: an enhanced status code of 5.5.6
items.condition: If, during an authentication exchange, the server receives a line that is longer than the server's authentication buffer

items.meaning: [StringPrep] 算法的 SASLprep 概要，用于在传输或比较前准备授权身份名称
items.constraint: both client and server SHOULD (*) use the [SASLprep] profile of the [StringPrep] algorithm to prepare these names for transmission or comparison
items.object: the [SASLprep] profile of the [StringPrep] algorithm to prepare these names for transmission or comparison

items.meaning: 认证交换中的服务端，在授权身份准备失败时被要求使认证失败
items.constraint: If preparation of the authorization identity fails or results in an empty string (unless it was transmitted as the empty string), the server MUST fail the authentication
items.object: the authentication
items.condition: If preparation of the authorization identity fails or results in an empty string
items.exception: (unless it was transmitted as the empty string)

items.meaning: 注释说明当前使用 SHOULD 等级、未来修订可能改为 MUST 的理由（非规范性）
SMTP 认证命令，服务端无法认证客户端时应用 535 回复拒绝
items.constraint: If the server is unable to authenticate the client, it SHOULD reject the AUTH command with a 535 reply unless a more specific error code is appropriate
items.object: the AUTH command with a 535 reply
items.condition: If the server is unable to authenticate the client
items.exception: unless a more specific error code is appropriate

items.meaning: SASL 交换中协商出的安全层，其生效时刻按客户端与服务端分别定义（描述性，无等级词）
安全层生效后必须丢弃从客户端获得的、非来自 SASL 协商的知识
items.constraint: The server MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the EHLO argument, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the EHLO argument, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.condition: When a security layer takes effect

items.meaning: 安全层生效后必须丢弃从服务端获得的、非来自 SASL 协商的知识
items.constraint: the client MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.condition: When a security layer takes effect

items.meaning: 客户端可比较认证前后通告的 SASL 机制以检测主动降级攻击
items.constraint: a client MAY compare the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication in order to detect an active down-negotiation attack
items.object: the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication

items.meaning: 客户端在成功完成 SASL 协商并启用安全层后应发送的 SMTP 命令
items.constraint: client SHOULD send EHLO as first command after successful SASL negotiation enabling a security layer
items.object: an EHLO command as the first command
items.condition: after a successful SASL negotiation that results in the enabling of a security layer

items.meaning: 当 TLS 与 SASL 安全层同时生效时，发送方必须采用的编码叠加顺序
items.constraint: TLS encoding MUST be applied after the SASL encoding
items.object: the TLS encoding after the SASL encoding
items.condition: When an entity (whether it is the client or the server end) is sending data, and both [TLS] and SASL security layers are in effect
items.normative_subject: an entity (whether it is the client or the server end)

items.meaning: 用于提交认证机制与凭据的 SMTP 命令
items.constraint: client MAY proceed without authentication if AUTH fails
items.object: without authentication
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: 认证交换中发起 AUTH 命令并提交凭据的实体
items.constraint: client MAY try another authentication mechanism or present different credentials by issuing another AUTH
items.action: try another authentication mechanism or present different credentials by issuing another AUTH
items.object: another authentication mechanism / different credentials
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: 实现 SASL 扩展的服务器端
items.constraint: server implementation MUST implement a configuration in which it does NOT permit any plaintext password mechanisms
items.object: a configuration in which it does NOT permit any plaintext password mechanisms
items.exception: unless either the STARTTLS [SMTP-TLS] command has been negotiated or some other mechanism that protects the session from password snooping has been provided

items.meaning: 部署服务器的站点（配置方）
items.constraint: Server sites SHOULD NOT use any configuration which permits a plaintext password mechanism without protection against password snooping
items.object: any configuration which permits a plaintext password mechanism without such a protection mechanism against password snooping

items.meaning: 必须在 TLS 之上实现的 SASL 机制
items.constraint: client and server implementations MUST implement the [PLAIN] SASL mechanism running over TLS
items.object: the [PLAIN] SASL mechanism running over TLS [TLS] [SMTP-TLS]

items.meaning: 新实现可以选择实现 CRAM-MD5 SASL 机制，以与已部署软件互操作
